Your craft is undergoing a digital renaissance where the hammer and chisel are increasingly replaced by generative design and precision robotics. While the physical soul of the stone remains your domain, AI has taken over the tedious precision work. Tasks like measuring materials, positioning equipment, and the repetitive execution of standard patterns are now handled by intelligent CNC systems. This shift allows you to move away from being a manual operator and toward becoming a digital artist and material consultant.

You will spend your time using Generative AI to sketch intricate, never-before-seen patterns that would have been too time-consuming to design by hand. By leveraging AI simulations, you can predict exactly how a rare slab of marble or granite will react to different pressures and temperatures, reducing waste and allowing for bolder experimentation. Your value lies in your 'eye' for quality and your ability to add the final, tactile human touches that a machine cannot replicate, ensuring each piece carries the weight of authentic craftsmanship.
